mods.aiSummary: Adds an upgraded version of the Hegemony Wolf ship with militarized auxiliary mods, extended shields, resistant flux conduits, and increased DP.

mods.name: Heggie Tales v0.6.8
mods.summary: A Quest Mod! Formerly known Tales from the Hegemony
mods.aiSummary: Adds a quest storyline involving the Hegemony, featuring new ships, officers, and lore expansions.

mods.name: High Tech Expansion
mods.summary: Adds a number of high-tech ships and weapons. Requires Magiclib and Lazylib. Has support for GraphicsLib shaders, but doesn't require it.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a number of high-tech ships and weapons.

mods.name: Hiigaran Descendants
mods.summary: Excerpts from a millennia-old Captain's Log, The Exile,
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Hiigaran faction, ships, and lore based on the Homeworld universe.

mods.name: Hillock Prototype and Station Tech Pack
mods.summary: Uncover the fragmented story of a distant binary system, and what became of it, through the vessels and blueprints you acquire. Codex entries have been scrubbed 'lost' over time. Collect them through exploration, underworld dealings, or lucky finds with Independents to access their descriptions.
mods.aiSummary: Adds new ships, fighters, weapons, and station tech to uncover the story of a distant binary system.

mods.name: Hiver Swarm
mods.summary: Hiver Swarm is a non player enemy AI faction designed to be aggressive invaders and can colonize systems. An insectoid race that uses high tech bio-cybernetics to grow their living ships. Their home world is found in deep space and their relations range from inhospitable to hostile for all factions.
mods.aiSummary: Adds an aggressive insectoid faction with living ships that colonize systems and attack the player.

mods.name: HMI Supervillians 0.0.5d
mods.summary: Adds two psychotic factions on the fringes of the Core.
mods.aiSummary: Adds two psychotic factions on the fringes of the Core.

mods.name: Holy Covenant of Kemet 0.0.4f
mods.summary: An isolationist, strictly hierarchical polity with a strong emphasis on high tech weaponry and incredibly garish ship designs, this Egyptian-themed faction is slowly emerging onto the wider Persean scene with strong suspicions by the hegemony of rampant AI utilisation.
mods.aiSummary: Adds an isolationist, Egyptian-themed faction with high-tech weaponry and garish ship designs.

mods.name: Hostile Intercept (and Autopause!)
mods.summary: This utility mod adds radiating rings around hostile and intercepting fleets so you can easily spot them. It also adds autopause!
mods.aiSummary: Adds radiating rings around hostile and intercepting fleets and introduces an autopause feature.

mods.name: Hull Mod Industrial Services
mods.summary: The full details are in the README over on Github linked above, but as a short description this mod adds a new Hull Mod Services colony structure which then lets you do the following (all using credits):
mods.aiSummary: Adds a colony structure that allows managing hull mods and ship restoration costs using credits.

mods.name: Hullmod Barratry
mods.summary: Now that little shpiel is out the way, hopefully you're less (or more) confused behind what barratry involves. Hullmod Barratry adds the option to be able to apply V-Mods (Vandal mods) to your ship hull on purpose, which are halved drawbacks/benefits counterparts of the base game D-Mods.
mods.aiSummary: Adds V-Mods, which are halved counterparts to base game D-Mods, and Scuff-Mods for cosmetic damage.

mods.name: Hullmods - Renewed v1.6.1
mods.summary: Extends the vanilla hullmod screen with better filters, search, custom groups, favourites/trashed hullmods, and has icons for their categorization.
mods.aiSummary: Extends the hullmod selection screen with advanced filtering, search, and organization tools.

mods.name: Hyder's Reach (mini-mod)
mods.summary: "Deputy Star Marshal Oxana Hyder is a dangerous fleet admiral, a capable strategist, and a woman of firm and sincere convictions. Unfortunately, all the wrong ones." -- Orcus Rao
mods.aiSummary: Adds a secret super-weapon variant of the Atropos torpedo to Sindrian fleets, enhancing their strategic capabilities.

mods.name: Hylecium Stargazers aka. White 0.2
mods.summary: The Stargazers are definitely Balanced™ in a way that only a few ships can already scare away a large fleet a few times fold. Very flux focused, with reliable flux related speed, high capacity and very reactive dissipation. Also has a minor faction on the side, would showcase if need be.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a flux-focused faction with high mobility and reactive dissipation.

mods.name: Hyperdrive
mods.summary: This mod allows your fleet to "hyperwarp," traveling up to 15 light-years in mere seconds. The goal is to improve the QoL involved in travel as much as possible without disrupting normal gameplay more than necessary.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a fleet ability to instantly travel long distances by hyperwarping.

mods.name: Hypershroud 2.0
mods.summary: Gives Hyperspace a bold new look, turning it into a deep, hungry crimson by default. If you’re feeling adventurous, you can swap it out for one of several alternate realities: Pink Delirium, Luddic Verdance, Cyan [REDACTED], Violet Warpstorm, and a secret fifth hue you’ll have to discover for yourself. Just move your chosen color set into the main graphics directory to shift the tone of the void.
mods.aiSummary: Changes the hyperspace visual style to a deep crimson by default, with options for other color schemes.

mods.name: Hyperspace Network - Information Services
mods.summary: Hyperspace Network, or HyperNET in short, is a sector-wide hyperspace network to query content of known markets.
mods.aiSummary: Provides a sector-wide network to query market content, search for personnel, and locate ships for sale.

mods.name: ICE Faction
mods.summary: Featuring 17 ships, 18 weapons, 7 ship systems, 7 hull mods, and 4 types of phase cloak
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with 17 ships, 18 weapons, and unique armor-repairing technology.

mods.name: Idoneus Citadel Exiles
mods.summary: This is an updated re-release of Sundog's classic mod, abandoned a few versions ago in 0.65. For those not in the know, ICE was a very complicated mod that used a lot of coding wizardry to work, but due to that same complexity, it stopped being updated.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction with new ships, hullmods, weapons, and campaign events.

mods.name: Illustrated.Entities
mods.summary: This mod contains around 1300 AI-generated illustrations for colonies that have been manually sorted and edited. It adds pre-specified images to all vanilla planets and can add fitting images to modded and newly established colonies.
mods.aiSummary: Adds AI-generated illustrations to planets and colonies, allowing players to customize descriptions and visuals.

mods.name: Immersion Friendly Portrait Pack
mods.summary: 28 Portraits
mods.aiSummary: Adds 28 new character portraits with three color themes.

mods.name: Immersive AI Portraits
mods.summary: This is a generated pack of portraits with theme-colored and glitchy style intended for use with AI-cores theme.
mods.aiSummary: Adds faction-themed and AI-core themed character portraits for captains.

mods.name: Improved Brawler
mods.summary: Changed the color of the sprite a bit so it doesn't look TOO much like the standard brawler
mods.aiSummary: Replaces the standard Brawler with an improved variant featuring increased speed, flux venting, and shield efficiency.

mods.name: Improved Smaller Ship PPT
mods.summary: I personally don't understand why smaller ships shouldn't last as long in battle as bigger ships, and I dislike having wolfpack strategies fail against endgame enemies because my ships ran out of PPT even with Hardened Subsystems, Combat Endurance, not using Safety Overrides, etc.
mods.aiSummary: Increases Peak Performance Time for frigates, destroyers, and cruisers to help smaller ships survive longer in battle.

mods.name: Imps Weapon Sounds
mods.summary: i'm a ballistic weapon fetishist and i found myself disappointed with the approach Starsector has with the weaponsound of everything that hurls a Metal Projectile with immense explosive force towards my enemy's.
mods.aiSummary: Replaces the sound effects of ballistic weapons with custom, tweaked audio.

mods.name: In Game Log Viewer
mods.summary: View logs from starsector.log inside the game.
mods.aiSummary: Displays game logs on screen with sound effects and in the console.

mods.name: Independent Interstellar
mods.summary: Adds more-militarized weapons of pirate mk2 ships, and a couple "what-if?" weapons. Not balanced and i didn't even attempt.
mods.aiSummary: Adds militarized variants of pirate ships and weapons, along with new hullmods.

mods.name: Independent Mining Faction(0.21b)
mods.summary: This mod adds a new faction, called the Independent Mining Faction, currently there are 10 ships(4 fighter, 2 frigate, 1 destroyer, 2 cruiser, 1 capital) and 8 weapons.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with 10 ships and 8 weapons focused on mining and combat.

mods.name: Independent Ship and Weapon Pack
mods.summary: A Ship and Weapon pack meant to expand the fleets and arsenals of the unaligned powers of the Persean Sector.
mods.aiSummary: Adds new ships, weapons, and fighters for unaligned factions.

mods.name: Indies Expansion Pack
mods.summary: Mod that add bunch of stuff to Indies and its less reputable cousin...
mods.aiSummary: Adds new ships, weapons, hullmods, and frontier systems focused on scavenger and indie gameplay.

mods.name: Industrial.Evolution
mods.summary: This mod is a massive content expansion that fits almost seamlessly into vanilla to add a multitude of new gameplay options, expanding primarily on exploration and colony gameplay.
mods.aiSummary: Adds new buildings, exploration content, events, consumables, and fleet management features.

mods.name: Intel - Renewed
mods.summary: Lets you decide what the intel screen shows. Hide whole kinds of entries, hide categories, hide single entries, drop the empty category buttons, and search the list.
mods.aiSummary: Lets you customize the intel screen by hiding specific entries, categories, or kinds of intel, and searching the list.

mods.name: Interastral Peace Casino
mods.summary: Gamble away your ships at the
mods.aiSummary: Adds a casino with poker, blackjack, gacha, and betting arenas to Tri-Tachyon and player markets.

mods.name: Interesting Portraits Pack
mods.summary: This pack has 345 375 portraits. All have been modified to fit the various factions or Starsector's aesthetic in general. All portraits are exclusive to each faction. I wanted to keep it immersive and complement the portraits that are already ingame.
mods.aiSummary: Adds 375 faction-exclusive character portraits and shoulder birds for captains.

mods.name: Internal Affairs Minimod
mods.summary: Internal Affairs is a lightweight minimod that adds one new simple event found in Tri-Tachyon bars, that you can complete once per playthrough. You'll be tasked with tracking down a disgraced executive. Good hunting!
mods.aiSummary: Adds a single one-time mission event in Tri-Tachyon bars to track down a disgraced executive.

mods.name: Interstellar Federation
mods.summary: Over a millennia ago, during a time of peace and exploration, mankind's greatest undertaking led to the creation of the Stardrive, a device capable of instantaneous travel between two points in space.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with capital ships, cruisers, destroyers, frigates, fighters, industrial ships, and unique weapons.

mods.name: Interstellar Federation (refurbished)
mods.summary: I have taken it onto myself to revive this great mod, which I adore very much, for the current version of the game. (and it barely took 2.5 years to get there) Some of my first Starsector experiences involved this mod all the way back to when Starsector didn't even have a galaxy map.
mods.aiSummary: Revives the Interstellar Federation faction with updated sprites and ship stats for the current game version.

mods.name: Interstellar Federation Legacy
mods.summary: This is the First version of Interstellar Federation Legacy mod. It's an update of the classic IF mod by Keptin that was discontinued a few years back. http://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=2012.0
mods.aiSummary: Updates the classic Interstellar Federation mod by converting its ships, weapons, and systems for the current game version.

mods.name: Interstellar Imperium
mods.summary: The Interstellar Imperium was once a decentralized vassal-state of the Domain of Man, ruled by a council of Domain-approved local magistrates, each controlling assets within a particular sector of space.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a complete faction with 21 flyable ships, 25 modular weapons, and 3 star systems.

mods.name: Iron Shell
mods.summary: Iron Shell is a faction mod based around increasing the arsenal and developing the lore behind the Fourteenth Battlegroup and Hegemony. A military division that specializes in commerce and carries its duties across the Persean Sector.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with new ships, fighters, weapons, and lore centered on the Fourteenth Battlegroup.

mods.name: Ironclads
mods.summary: The mod tells a story of humanity`s future. It is 206 years after the first FTL jump made by humans. As soon as the unmanned probe returned from the first FTL travel to a nearby star - it became clear that space contains a lot of riches that await to be harvested.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a total conversion with new factions, ships, weapons, and gameplay mechanics like mining and salvaging.

mods.name: ISAF - RC5
mods.summary: Brief Summary: -Mini-mod. Two ships. One weapon. Custom starts to start off with Sakers and Super Sakers. That's it.
mods.aiSummary: Adds two ships, one weapon, and custom starts featuring Sakers and Super Sakers.

mods.name: ISAF Mini-Mod - RC0.98
mods.summary: It's been a couple of years since I've touched anything related to Starsector, until I built a new PC and re-installed it on a whim. After tweaking a few lines of text to make sure it still works with 0.98, I thought I'd just drop the files in here in case anyone out here still wished to add some Ace Combat-flavoured unbalanced protagonist fighter energy to their game, especially in light of AC8's announcement.
mods.aiSummary: Adds two Ace Combat-inspired starfighters, a weapon, and custom starts featuring Sakers and Super Sakers.

mods.name: Isekai Portraits
mods.summary: A portrait pack adding 456 images in an Anime style based on characters from across various Anime, Manga, Video Games and "hand holding" works with some outfit variations
mods.aiSummary: Adds 456 anime-style portraits based on characters from various media.

mods.name: It Came From Beyond 0.1.3
mods.summary: Adds a new faction called the Boundless, ships to go along with them, and campaign-level features such as a new storyline and ability.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction, ships, and campaign features including a new storyline and ability.

mods.name: Item Markers
mods.summary: Adds visual markers to wanted items and ships for easy identification.
mods.aiSummary: Adds visual markers to wanted items and ships for easy identification.

mods.name: Jackundor's Advanced Arms
mods.summary: A simple and quite small weapon and fighter pack. Adds 2 new fighter wings and 8 new weapons to the game. The weapons and fighters are generally accessible to a few of the vanilla factions, from pirates to hegemony, from tri-tachyon to independents.
mods.aiSummary: Adds 2 new fighter wings and 8 new weapons accessible to various vanilla factions.

mods.name: JaegerTech 1.0.0
mods.summary: A smol mod that adds a scuffed-up phase tender to the game.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a scuffed-up phase tender to the game.

mods.name: Java 21 - 1.2
mods.summary: This mod lets Starsector work with Java 21. It does this by making some modifications to both Starsector's and Java's code as it is loaded. It only tweaks things to work, does not update any of starsectors libs nor does it repackage code. Because of this it will LIKELY work with most recent versions of Starsector.
mods.aiSummary: Enables the game to run on Java 21 by modifying code at load time.

mods.name: Java 24 [Mikohime 27] [Win/Linux]
mods.summary: a Conversion Kit to run Starsector on Latest Java 24, Provides up to 90% FPS & Stability Improvement over Stock Vanilla in Campaign with SUPER STABLE COMBAT FPS, the kit came with pre-configured Modern Java GC Shenandoah to ensure smooth and long run gameplay stability.
mods.aiSummary: Provides a conversion kit to run the game on Java 24 for improved FPS and stability.

mods.name: JaydeePiracy
mods.summary: A series of hopefully unique and interesting ships. My eventual goal was to kitbash a ship for every faction as an exercise for myself, now that that has been accomplished, the new direction for this mod is mostly bounties, quests and campaign level content.
mods.aiSummary: Adds unique ships for various factions, player faction flags, and campaign-level exploration content.

mods.name: JaydeeProficiencies
mods.summary: JaydeeProficiencies is a generic Library Mod used by JaydeePiracy and related projects.
mods.aiSummary: Provides a library framework for customizing player factions, UI colors, and managing hireable specialists with skill trees.

mods.name: Junk Pirates
mods.summary: A restored compatibility release of mendonca's Junk Pirates, PACK, and ASP Syndicate content for Starsector 0.98a-RC8. This fork is a local restoration pass for modern Starsector.
mods.aiSummary: Restores and updates Junk Pirates, PACK, and ASP Syndicate content for modern Starsector.

mods.name: Junk Pirates
mods.summary: The Junk Pirates themselves are one of the oldest mods for Starsector (even featured in a Blog Post back in 2011!).
mods.aiSummary: Adds three new factions with unique ships, artwork, and music.

mods.name: Junk Yard Dogs
mods.summary: A powerful neutralist faction mod that focuses on ships that excel at mining, scrapping, exploration and survey
mods.aiSummary: Adds a neutralist faction focused on mining, scrapping, and exploration with new ships, weapons, and a salvage-heavy system.

mods.name: Kadur Remnant
mods.summary: New starting options when used with Vayra's Sector, including a starting option aligned with the Kadur Remnant
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Kadur Remnant faction with new ships, weapons, and star systems.

mods.name: Kadur Remnants
mods.summary: Hello! I have obtained permission to bring Kadur Remnant into a relative 0.98a-RC8 support! However, these changes may or may not reflect Vayra's intent, but I hope it makes the Kadur Remnants more playable and brings a better experience!
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Kadur Remnant faction, featuring unique ships, weapons, and missions.

mods.name: Kaleidoscope
mods.summary: This mod adds over 70 new planet textures to the game to increase the variety of planets you can find. It also adds some variations to the planet types that exist, but no new ones and no new conditions (get Unknown Skies for that!).
mods.aiSummary: Adds over 70 new planet textures to increase visual variety.

mods.name: Kang Charter
mods.summary: Adds a faction with their own versions of existing ships, lore and a system deep in uncharted space.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction with defensive ship variants, a new system, and lore.

mods.name: Kazeron Avionics 1.3b (and Sierra Addon 1.0)
mods.summary: An aggressive and carrier-focused Midline ship-and-wing pack inspired by Diable Avionics, featuring the following: 4 new battlecarriers, one for each hull type (Vent, Rafale, Trombe, Ouragan) and 1 civilian auxiliary cruiser (Alruna), all sporting the ACE Combat Suite shipsystem (+25% timeflow, -33% damage taken, enable direct control of deployed wings);
mods.aiSummary: Adds Midline battlecarriers, wings, strikecrafts, and weapons inspired by Diable Avionics.

mods.name: Kazeron Avionics
mods.summary: An aggressive and carrier-focused Midline ship-and-wing pack inspired by Diable Avionics, featuring the following:
mods.aiSummary: Adds aggressive Midline battlecarriers, EWAR platforms, wings, strikecrafts, and weapons inspired by Diable Avionics.

mods.name: Kazeron Navarchy
mods.summary: "Adds several skins to the Persean League, each with the Kazeron Navarchy hullmod built in. They appear occasionally in Persean League markets and fleets.
mods.aiSummary: Adds several skins to the Persean League, each with the Kazeron Navarchy hullmod built in.

mods.name: Kazeron Navarchy
mods.summary: Adds several skins to the Persean League, each with the Kazeron Navarchy hullmod built in. They appear occasionally in Persean League markets and fleets.
mods.aiSummary: Adds several skins to the Persean League, each with the Kazeron Navarchy hullmod built in.

mods.name: Keruvim Shipyards
mods.summary: Keruvim Shipyards were a once prominent construction company contracted by the Domain of Man before the collapse, building new and advanced ships for every walk of life and often butting heads with the Tri-Tachyon Corporation.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction focused on battle carriers and fighter superiority with high industrial power.

mods.name: Keyboard As Mouse - An Accessibility(?) Mod
mods.summary: This mod is built on a sort of library I'm referring to as True Input Faker, which it uses to generate fake mouse events (and possibly fake keyboard events in the future) by injecting itself between Starsector and the LWJGL game library it's built on.
mods.aiSummary: Allows using the keyboard to control the in-game cursor, including clicks, movement, scrolling, and dragging.

mods.name: Khe's Tech
mods.summary: This mod is almost exclusively hullmods that make fairly big changes to the ships they are used on. There's also 4 MagicLib Bounties...with one featuring a very painful, challenging and probably unfun fight and its reward being one each of two new ships this mod adds as well as two hullmods.
mods.aiSummary: Adds rare hullmods, new ships, and bounties that significantly alter ship performance and combat mechanics.

mods.name: Kiith Nabaal Shipyard
mods.summary: Honoring the 20th anniversary of the Homeworld franchise and the upcoming sequel announced today, a small mod to introduce the ships of Homeworld 2 into Starsector.
mods.aiSummary: Introduces ships from Homeworld 2 into the game.

mods.name: Kingdom of Royal Azalea
mods.summary: This mod adds a new faction, The Kingdom of Royal Azalea and several systems, mostly in the northeastern in the edge of the sector. The entire faction is centered around "Magic" and "Mages", translated in a way that works with Starsector's engine.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new magic-themed faction with defensive ships featuring multi-layered shields and spell-casting ship systems.

mods.name: Kingdom of Terra
mods.summary: In the belly of their hollow planet, the Kingdom of Terra plans its uprising! Prepare your trembling Sector for the marvels of science gone awry, and the horrors of nature unleashed!
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with dinosaur-themed ships, weapons, and lore centered on a hollow planet.

mods.name: KMLib
mods.summary: Currently in pre-release. Requires LazyLib and LunaLib. Safe to enable mid-save, uninstalled via settings.
mods.aiSummary: Provides library support required by the Political Map mod.
mods.partOfThreadTitle: Political Map - Sector Map Layers - KMU

mods.name: Knights Hospitaller - Unique Luddic Church Quest, Ship, Questline
mods.summary: "Knights Hospitaller" adds a Luddic humanitarian order to the Sector: the Knights Hospitaller, white-cloaked battlefield rescuers centered around the Abundant Mercy, a unique Invictus stationed over Gilead.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a Luddic humanitarian order featuring a unique Invictus ship and a questline.

mods.name: Knights Templar
mods.summary: The Knights Templar arrived in the Sector several decades ago, startling the Sector with a display of technology never before seen. Far above and beyond the level of manmade technology, the ships and weapons they wield are thought to be alien in origin, adapted for human use.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a hostile faction with advanced alien-derived technology, powerful ships, and aggressive crusade campaigns.

mods.name: Known Skies 1.1.0
mods.summary: A mod that adds a "special" new unique star in the sector which gives buffs to all planets in its system. It will randomly replace a procgen star like the unique planets from Unknown Skies. Also adds a command for ConsoleCommands which allows you to convert any star into that special star.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a special unique star that buffs all planets in its system and randomly replaces a procedural star.

mods.name: Kon's Player Faction Bundles
mods.summary: Offers changes to the player faction to make it feel more part of the world + other optional add-ons. This mod is broken into six distinct submods that can be enabled or disabled independently.
mods.aiSummary: Overhauls the player faction with custom descriptions, fleet names, and dialogue, and offers optional submods for ships, weapons, UI colors, and blueprint recovery.

mods.name: Krysan Federal Navy - Update 43.1 Arvalis Oopsies
mods.summary: A faction pack inspired by The Expanse TV Series with a dose of 86 and a copious amounts of PD and rat-related puns
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction pack inspired by The Expanse TV Series with high-speed warships and strong point defense.

mods.name: Kwin's Sector Industry Compilation
mods.summary: A Starsector faction and content compilation for 0.98a, Kwin's Sector Industry Compilation adds four lore-rich corporations with unique ships, weapons, fighters, hullmods, colony Charter Offices, and specialized procurement storefronts.
mods.aiSummary: Adds four lore-rich corporations with unique ships, weapons, fighters, hullmods, colony Charter Offices, and specialized procurement storefronts.

mods.summary: Kyeltziv Technocracy is a Faction Mod that includes a selection of ships and weapons with a focus on drone shipsystems and long range combat.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction focused on drone shipsystems and long range combat.

mods.name: Lakhesis Monarchy - 1.1c
mods.summary: Possible imbalance. Download if you are fine with that.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Lakhesis Monarchy faction with new ships and weaponry.

mods.name: Lancer RPG/Battlegroup 0.0.2 [WIP}
mods.summary: This is a ship, weapon, and a (small) faction mod based on the Lancer RPG setting created by Massif Press*. Currently, there is one cruiser** and one weapon implemented. This is a very tentative state of affairs, and any feedback (balancing, bugs, etc.) is highly appreciated.
mods.aiSummary: Adds ships, weapons, and a faction based on the Lancer RPG setting.

mods.name: Larger Zoom Out
mods.summary: This simple mod increases the maximum camera range you can zoom out on the battle and campaign screens.
mods.aiSummary: Increases the maximum camera zoom-out range on battle and campaign screens.

mods.name: Lauren Cinematic Dogfights AI v1.0
mods.summary: Cinematic dogfights between fighters and interceptors. Bombers focused on the bombing run. Interceptors intercept. Requires lazylib.
mods.aiSummary: Adds cinematic dogfights between fighters and interceptors, with bombers focused on bombing runs.

mods.name: LazyLib
mods.summary: LazyLib is not a regular mod. It doesn't add any ships, weapons or factions. In fact, it doesn't change anything at all in your game! All it does is make writing code for mods easier.
mods.aiSummary: Provides a library of utility methods for modders to simplify complex coding tasks like collision detection and sector messages.

mods.name: Leading Pip
mods.summary: The image kind of speaks for itself, but to clarify, this mod adds a target leading pip in front of whatever ship you have targeted. If you shoot at that pip, you will generally hit the target.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a target leading pip in front of targeted ships to help aim weapons.

mods.name: League of Geeks (EN Translation)
mods.summary: Enjoy a rough G Translate / DeepL translation version of the League of Geeks provided by one of the CN Authors.
mods.aiSummary: Adds an energy-focused faction and rebel subfaction featuring crystal-themed weapons, missions, and a unique upgrading system.

mods.name: Legacy of Arkgneisis
mods.summary: Legacy of Arkgneisis currently adds a single faction to the campaign, that of the Anarakis Reparations Society, a duplicitous quasi nation of privateers and terrorists that make the reaches of deep space their home.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Anarakis Reparations Society faction, featuring unique ships, weapons, and stations.

mods.name: Legacy of Leonis (mini-mod)
mods.summary: 10 New Kit-bashed Ships for Starsector for Pirates, Independents, and the Luddic Church. As with all of my nonsense, focused on the early and mid-game. (Some of these kit bashes are mine, others are from the Spiral Arms II thread, all credit to their proper owners)
mods.aiSummary: Adds ten kit-bashed ships for pirates, independents, and the Luddic Church, focusing on early and mid-game raiding and combat tankers.

mods.name: Legacy Waving Banners
mods.summary: A mod that turns all faction flags into wavy banners. It includes all the vanilla factions, some modded ones and some custom flags for players to choose from.
mods.aiSummary: Replaces faction flags with wavy banner designs.

mods.name: Lemon MEGA portrait pack [MINI UPDATE]
mods.summary: 300 - 400+ weeb-ish portrait pack generated by torturing local alpha core, crude, and unfiltered because im too lazy to sort it all.
mods.aiSummary: Adds 300-400+ anime-style portraits for various factions.

mods.name: Less Supplies for Maintenance
mods.summary: A simple mod to reduce the amount of supplies burnt by your fleet for maintenance.
mods.aiSummary: Reduces the monthly supplies cost for fleet maintenance by dividing it by four.

mods.name: Library of Ruina Portrait Pack
mods.summary: This is a portrait pack containing all of your beloved (and hated) characters from the hit game among us Library of Ruina. Except all of the characters I deemed to be *too* out of place for starsector (mostly E.G.O.

mods.name: Takeshido v1.1.1

mods.name: Weftin's Ship Pack
mods.summary: Adds 21 Midline ships (with some high tech flavor added in) to the sector.
mods.aiSummary: Adds 21 midline ships with high-tech flavor to the sector.

mods.name: Weird Portrait pack (55+17 pictures) (pictures added)
mods.summary: Weird stuff, in case your into it. Feel free to use it for whatever.

mods.name: Well Advised Modifications

mods.aiSummary: Turns Ill Advised Modifications into a harmless flavor mod.

mods.name: WH Rogue Trader Portrait Pack V1.0
mods.summary: This mod adds over 40 portraits from the game Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader, playable characters, companions and some of the major characters, in addition to that there are also 3 portraits from the concept art of the game 40k Darktide.
mods.aiSummary: Adds over 40 portraits from Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader and 3 from Darktide concept art.

mods.name: What May Be Safely Written: The Eldest 0.1 (Conceptual WIP, LF Coder, Artist)
mods.summary: It's a rarely shared but firmly held opinion of mine that no game is complete without a touch of cosmic horror, at least one appearance by things-that-should-not-be. So Here's my ongoing attempt at putting a bit of that sort of thing into Starfarer.
mods.aiSummary: Adds cosmic horror elements, including a mission involving a Phage and new ships.

mods.name: What We Left Behind
mods.summary: This mod focuses on exploration and colony content, with a particular incline towards cosmic horror and esoteric nonsense. Various terrifying secrets exist in the reaches of the sector, waiting for you to discover them.
mods.aiSummary: Adds exploration and colony content with a focus on cosmic horror and interconnected world reactions.

mods.name: Which-industry
mods.summary: It's simple mod that adds to industry tooltip info from what mod industry/structure is
mods.aiSummary: Adds tooltip information indicating which mod provides each industry or structure.

mods.name: WhichMod
mods.summary: This mod adds the mod title to the descriptions of all weapons, ships, fighters, and hullmods added by mods.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the source mod's name to the descriptions of weapons, ships, fighters, and hullmods.

mods.name: WhichTMI
mods.summary: WhichTMI adds subtext with exact numerical info for some weapon stats that are otherwise hidden from the player one way or another. This mod does not add anything fancy and is only intended to be used as a companion to TMI, or as a lightweight variation on it.
mods.aiSummary: Adds subtext with exact numerical info for some weapon stats that are otherwise hidden from the player.

mods.name: Whisper's Techmining Alterations
mods.summary: * Techmining is a structure, not infrastructure (since it doesn't benefit the faction/planet directly)
mods.aiSummary: Overhauls techmining mechanics by treating it as a structure with decay rates, progress bars for special items, and configurable loot values based on ruins and colony size.

mods.name: Wide Horizons (Basic) - Expanding the Universe
mods.summary: Wide Horizons lets you expand the Starsector galaxy by up to 300%. With in-game setting, the entire universe scales up: sector size, star systems, ruins, Remnants, gates, and more.
mods.aiSummary: Expands the galaxy size by up to 300% with realistic system generation and faction redistribution.

mods.name: Wingman Project: Online Combat Co-op battles for Starsector.(BETA)
mods.summary: Co-op multiplayer for Starsector battles. One player hosts a battle (a mission, the simulator or a campaign fight) and up to three friends(default, goes up to 16 but why would you do that?) join it, each flying a ship from the host's fleet, side by side, in real time.
mods.aiSummary: Adds co-op multiplayer for Starsector battles, letting up to three friends join a host's fight in real time.

mods.name: WIP - Beyond The Black: a BSG and The Expanse inspired hard sci fi mod
mods.summary: This mod is basically the two shows mixed together, with a few Starsector things added in as well as flavor.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a hard sci-fi combat system inspired by Battlestar Galactica and The Expanse, featuring custom factions, ships, and weapons.

mods.name: WIP Aardwolf & Zenith: ARRUS Hullmods
mods.summary: A modest collection of additional hullmods to help customise the way you like to play. Most of the included hullmods are based off augmenting or offsetting a variety of vanilla hullmods. As such most of them have dependencies on vanilla hullmods and/or each other.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a collection of hullmods for customizing ship builds, including augmentations, reversions, rectifications, upgrades, and stopgaps.

mods.name: Wishgranters Faction
mods.summary: From left to right we have:
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with Norse mythology-themed ships and standardized weapon loadouts.

mods.name: Wondrous Weapons (Will Update When I Get A Free Week Ed.)
mods.summary: -A content expansion pack for Starsector, featuring many common ships, weapons, and (more content to come!)
mods.aiSummary: Adds a content expansion pack featuring many common ships and weapons.

mods.name: World War

mods.aiSummary: Adds a Chinese-language mod body that requires a separate language pack for English translation.

mods.name: World War Mod
mods.summary: This is a complete chinese language mod! So, this mod gives those who can read chinese language. And I hope can find someone help me translate it into english language.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a Chinese-language overhaul featuring a multi-satellite map, industrial ship production, trade systems, and faction relationships.

mods.name: Worldsmith Console Commands 1.3.0
mods.summary: Reshape the Sector from the console.
mods.aiSummary: Adds console commands to reshape the sector, build worlds, and manage factions.

mods.name: Wow Portraits
mods.summary: Ok, so it's not that WoW (World of Warcraft) kind of Portraits, but hear me out. This Mod aims to replace the Vanilla portraits and add some extra, to make the game feel more SciFi. As a Disclaimer: These portraits have been generated with Easy Stable Difussion, but trust me it was no easy task.
mods.aiSummary: Replaces vanilla character portraits with AI-generated sci-fi style images.

mods.name: XCOM Player Flags
mods.summary: I noticed a Terra Invicta flag pack and thought, "Why not put up flags from where their dev team started, LW/LW2?"
mods.aiSummary: Adds player faction flags inspired by XCOM and XCOM 2.

mods.name: Xxarra's Variety Pack (XVP) v0.1a.3
mods.summary: A content expansion that adds ships, exploration content, custom starts, and expands upon existing vanilla content.
mods.aiSummary: Adds ships, exploration content, custom starts, and expands upon existing vanilla content.

mods.name: XXVII Battle group v0.9.7
mods.summary: Add a mid-tech battle group. Having some vanilla-like ships. Having some special faction weapons, but all of these are build-in their ships.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a mid-tech battle group faction with vanilla-like ships and specialized faction weapons.

mods.name: Yellow - Ynadar Nexus Alliance (0.3) Mod
mods.summary: The Ynadar Alliance was bit of an inside joke to complete the triad of the three primary color factions I was told to do.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction focused on a midline armada with long-range missiles and weapons.

mods.name: Yuki's Tactical Display
mods.summary: Adds a tactical display widget to the combat UI anchored to the left side of the screen, with configurable position. Shows your fleet along with their assignments and status, as well as flux bars and CR/PPT in visual form.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a configurable tactical display widget to the combat UI showing fleet status, assignments, and flux bars.

mods.name: Yuri Expedition
mods.summary: This mod adds the new faction, Caparice Trade Co. in the Sola system in the eastern fringe of the sector.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Caparice Trade Co. faction with glass cannon missile ships and heavily armored bruisers.

mods.name: ZA WARUDO
mods.summary: Turns phase and temporal shell into a jojo reference.
mods.aiSummary: Turns phase and temporal shell into a jojo reference.

mods.name: Zer0Morph's Waving Banners
mods.summary: Turns all faction banners into something more... wavy
mods.aiSummary: Replaces faction banners with animated, waving flag sprites.

mods.name: Zoey's Faction Customization
mods.summary: Adds a few ways to customize your faction!
mods.aiSummary: Adds options to customize faction colors, fleet names, rank names, descriptions, and legal commodities.

mods.name: ZORG - - (Exerelin + Uomoz Compatible!) - Campaign Mode!
mods.summary: The ZORG mod adds a dozen new ships and weapons, plus new hullmods, portraits and ship systems. The campaign mode features a custom Zorg system, featuring unique celestial bodies, a Zorg station and spawnpoints. The Zorg spawn within their own system and spread out through hyperspace.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with unique ships, weapons, hullmods, and a custom campaign system.
